استلهمن (form X)
# اِسْتَلْهَمْنَ (istalhamna) /is.tal.ham.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اُسْتُلْهِمْنَ (ustulhimna) /us.tul.him.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اِسْتَلْهِمْنَ (istalhimna) /is.tal.him.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
